blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former House Speaker and Leyte Representative Martin Romualdez is now at the New Quezon City Jail in Barangay Payatas on Monday night. Romualdez came from the Philippine General Hospital (PGH) where he was confined over the weekend. The convoy of Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) personnel from PGH brought Romualdez to the jail facility at 10:49 p.m. BJMP spokesperson Capt. Jayrex Bustinera confirmed Romualdez’s arrival at the jail facility. Bustinera said the lawmaker will undergo standard booking procedures such as medical evaluation, fingerprint, mugshot, interview, and orientation.
